domains.note: no protocol or registration mentioned. Read Abstract, Introduction, Literature review, all four question sections, Recommendations, Conclusion and Disclaimer. No protocol, PROSPERO or registration wording anywhere in the text.

domains.evidence_quote: Most articles retrieved when searching for

3b-iii line 3: neither (a) a screening account with counts nor (b) inclusion/exclusion criteria is reported. Read Introduction and Literature review, the sections where a selection process would appear, and the rest of the text. No PRISMA, flow, screening, eligibility or criteria wording anywhere.

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.note: no appraisal step anywhere. Read Literature review, the safety section ('Will it increase the patient's functional or biomechanical risks?'), and Conclusion. Cited studies are summarised without any quality, bias or appraisal wording in the text.
no synthesis method is described and no quantitative pooling was done. Read the whole text and found no statistical, pooling, heterogeneity or synthesis-method wording.
no publication-bias assessment. Read the whole text and found no publication bias, funnel plot or small-study wording.

sources.fact_fa: این مقاله امتیاز ۵ و باند E (background / opinion level) در نوع سؤال THERAPY گرفت.
sources.interpretation_fa: این متن یک narrative review است و پایگاه‌های جست‌وجو، معیار انتخاب و ارزیابی کیفیت مطالعات را گزارش نمی‌کند. به همین دلیل امتیازش در سطح نظر کارشناسی است. ارزش بالینی‌اش در چارچوب تصمیم‌گیری برای تغییر OVD در بیماران دندان‌دار است، مثل رابطه‌ی 1:2:3 و ترتیب mock-up. این چارچوب برداشت نویسندگان است و یافته‌ی آزموده‌شده نیست.

of posterior interferences during functional movements.

claims.source_quote:
Re-
movable prostheses and occlusal splints fail
to provide an accurate assessment due to
instability and non-physiological contours
that may interfere with comfort, function,
and phonetics.

claims.claim_quote: به گفته‌ی Spear (2006) که مقاله نقلش کرده، اسپلینت فرم طبیعی دندان رو نداره، ثبات کافی نمی‌ده و حرف زدن رو مختل می‌کنه، پس چیزی که بیمار باهاش تجربه می‌کنه شبیه درمان نهایی نیست.
claims.source_quote:
In 2006, Spear 24
noted that using an occlusal splint for a pe-
riod of time to assess the viability of a new
OVD is not valid because the splint lacks
natural contours, does not provide maxi-
mum stability, and interferes with phonet-
ics, although it may be useful for depro-
gramming the neuromuscular system and
determining the maxillomandibular rela-
tionship.
claims.note: inference after پس judged on its conclusion, read as a restatement of the splint not being valid to assess a new OVD

claims.claim_quote: اگه بیمار اوایل کار علائم خفیفی داشت نگران نشو.

In some patients, mild
transient symptoms may occur, but mostly
they are self-limiting and without major
consequences.
claims.note: instruction judged against the reported effect (F2-iii way 2): favourable

claims.claim_quote: طبق مرور Abduo (2012) که مقاله بهش استناد کرده، این علائم معمولاً ظرف حدود دو هفته خودبه‌خود برطرف می‌شن.
claims.source_quote:
Abduo 6 concluded that, whenever
indicated, a permanent increase of the OVD
of up to 5 mm is a safe and predictable pro-
cedure without detrimental consequences,
and that the associated signs and symptoms
are self-limiting, with a tendency to resolve
within 2 weeks.

claims.claim_quote: OVD توی این ترتیب نقطه‌ی شروع نیست و نتیجه‌ی تصمیم‌های قبلیه، و هرچی تغییرش کمتر باشه بیمار راحت‌تر باهاش سازگار می‌شه.
claims.source_quote:
The smaller the change
in OVD, the less the need for an adaptive
response from the stomatognathic sys-
tem.
claims.note: the OVD-as-consequence half matches the sentence on deciding OVD once the incisal edge lengthening is approved

fidelity.source_conclusion: Subjective parameters such as facial harmony, speech resonance, and comfort must also be addressed and ap- proved by the patient.

fidelity.interpretation_fa: هر ادعای قابل‌بررسی با منبع مطابق است.
